reviewScope: Complete lexical candidate review of the public scene adapter. Three accessible names are localizable, fallback dimension/category presentation is deferred to domain ownership, and contract/validation/DOM/runtime values remain technical. Public viewer catches adapter failures and shows its generic unavailable message.
limitations: Inventory only; adapter code and locale resources remain unchanged.
Measurement units and catalog category fallback require a domain owner before resource design.
The existing generic public-viewer error intentionally suppresses internal adapter diagnostics.
